card.name: Gaps and brackets in state law citations
card.fires_on: Spaces, open parentheses, bullets and commas that come right before a bill number, legislator name or date in state law or legislative text. Also the end of 'naloxone' in 'state naloxone dispensing'.

modes.label: Punctuation before bill or code citation
modes.description: An open parenthesis or bullet right after a bill number or state law name, leading into a sponsor name or code reference.

modes.label: Space inside a date
modes.description: The space between a month and day in a law's effective date.

modes.label: End of state naloxone
modes.description: The last piece of 'naloxone' in the counseling instruction about state naloxone dispensing rules.
